name: Hit the Mark (Combat)
body:
Your decisive blow helps your allies strike true.

Prerequisite(s): Weapon focus with a non-light thrown weapon, base attack bonus +6

Benefit(s): You may make an attack against a creature with your chosen weapon as a standard action, if you hit, your blow throws your target off balance, rendering the target flat-footed until hit by an attack or the end of the round, whichever comes first. If your attack is a critical hit you may forgo the benefits of that critical hit; if you do, the next creature that hits your target before the end of the round automatically confirms a critical hit.
